sentences.text: The overall tone is mostly negative, and the average star rating is 1.9 out of 5 from 26 rated reviews.
Login & account is a common complaint: 8 of the 8 analysed reviews that mention it read as negative, with reviewers stating 'I can't log in, the OTP never arrives' and 'Login keeps failing'.
Ads is a common complaint: 5 of the 5 analysed reviews that mention it read as negative, with reviewer stating 'Too many ads, very annoying'.
The overall tone is mostly positive, with 50.0% of reviews reading as positive, and the average star rating is 3.0 out of 5 from 24 rated reviews.
The camera is mostly praised: all 4 analysed reviews that mention it read as positive, with reviewers saying "Camera takes excellent photos".
Delivery is mostly praised: 3 of the 4 analysed reviews that mention it read as positive, with one reviewer saying "Fast delivery and well packed".
Performance is a common complaint: 2 of the 3 analysed reviews that mention it read as negative, with one reviewer saying "Performance is laggy and it heats up".

Battery is mostly praised, with 22 of the 31 analysed reviews that mention it reading as positive, and display is also mostly praised, with 20 of the 23 analysed reviews that mention it reading as positive.
